slides.title: Families leaving Tselemti
slides.body: Opposition party Salsay Weyane Tigray says severe hunger is forcing residents of Laelay Tselemti to abandon their homes (Nov 17). Not independently verified.

slides.title: Emergency hunger possible in early 2027

slides.title: Already critical before September
slides.body: A Refugees International survey of 452 Tigray households (Aug-Sep) found widespread hunger and child malnutrition.
